description: Figure: calibration of the structure-anchored pocket score across 14 binders, 4 degenerate KCNH CNBH domains and 4 TAX-2 orthologs
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
df=pd.read_csv("out/pocket_score_calibration.csv")
order=df.sort_values("pocket_score",ascending=True)
cols={"binder":"#2b7bba","non-binder (CNBHD)":"#c0392b","TEST":"#e8a33d"}
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,7))
y=np.arange(len(order))
ax.barh(y,order.pocket_score,color=[cols[g] for g in order.group],edgecolor="k",linewidth=0.5)
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(order.protein,fontsize=9)
for i,(s,r) in enumerate(zip(order.pocket_score,order.pocket_residues)):
    ax.text(s+0.012,i,f"{s:.2f}  {r}",va="center",fontsize=7,family="monospace")
ax.axvline(df.loc[df.group=="non-binder (CNBHD)","pocket_score"].max(),color="#c0392b",ls="--",lw=1)
ax.axvline(df.loc[df.protein=="TAX2_CAEEL","pocket_score"].values[0],color="#e8a33d",ls="--",lw=1)
ax.set_xlim(0,1.38); ax.set_xlabel("Weighted pocket score vs the 15 cGMP-contact positions of TAX-4 (PDB 5H3O)")
ax.set_title("TAX-2 pocket scores inside the CNG/HCN binder cluster and above every degenerate KCNH CNBH domain",fontsize=10)
h=[plt.Rectangle((0,0),1,1,color=cols[k]) for k in ["binder","non-binder (CNBHD)","TEST"]]
ax.legend(h,["cyclic-nucleotide binder","KCNH CNBH domain, does not bind","TAX-2 orthologs (test)"],loc="lower right",fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
